# TokenEconomizer lab

> Real pinned Microsoft TokenEconomizer execution on synthetic traces, without provider calls.

Tier: ungraded
Status: partial
Interfaces: cli
Entrypoint: make -C labs/token-economizer-lab prepare; make -C labs/token-economizer-lab run
Auth: none
Spec: none (bounded experiment; JSON report and acceptance contract documented below)

Runs envfacts, live tool-pruning evidence/apply/restore, paused-judge loop-guard backstop and cache-aware accounting. Not an installation, live model evaluation, savings benchmark or production service.

## Interface reference

- [README](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/token-economizer-lab/README.md): commands, isolation and limits.
- [SUCCESS](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/token-economizer-lab/SUCCESS.md): dated acceptance and remaining gaps.
- [Report](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/token-economizer-lab/docs/evidence/report.json): real runtime outputs, explicitly synthetic inputs.

## Optional

- [Design](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/token-economizer-lab/SDD.md): bounded questions and ACs.
- [Upstream lock](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/token-economizer-lab/upstream.lock.json): commit and package SHA-256 hashes.
